concerns.text: FR-009 (Species-level aggregation fallback) is partially covered but critically incomplete. T020a-c implement the logic, but T019 (merge) and T021 (final output) are marked as missing/unchecked. Without T019 and T021, the pipeline cannot produce the 'clean, merged analysis-ready dataset' required by US-1 and FR-001/FR-006, blocking the entire downstream analysis.

FR-004 (PGLS/Spearman) and FR-005 (FDR correction) lack implementing tasks. T028a-c (Method Selection, PGLS, Spearman) and T029a-b (BH FDR, Permutation FDR) are unchecked. T030-T033 (Filtering, Edge Cases, Metrics) are also unchecked. This leaves the core statistical analysis (US-2) unimplemented, violating the spec's requirement to compute correlations and apply FDR.

FR-008 (Visualization & Notebook) and SC-003 (Reproducibility) are unimplemented. T034-T035 (Tests), T036-T037 (Heatmap), T038a-c (Notebook skeleton), T039a-b (Numerical equivalence), and T040a-c (Metrics) are all unchecked. The pipeline cannot generate the required heatmap or reproducible notebook, failing US-3.

Foundational infrastructure is incomplete. T004 (Logging), T006 (Isolate model), T007 (GenomicFeature model), T008 (SpeciesAggregate model), and T009 (Requirements) are unchecked. These are prerequisites for all user stories; their absence blocks the implementation of US-1, US-2, and US-3.

T011-T014 (Tests for US-1) are marked as complete (checked), but the corresponding implementation tasks (T015-T021) are largely unchecked. While TDD is a valid strategy, the current state implies tests exist for non-existent code, which is a planning inconsistency. The tasks should be re-evaluated to ensure the 'test-first' approach is explicitly documented as the current state, or the implementation tasks should be prioritized.

T022-T025 (Tests for US-2) are marked as complete, but the implementation tasks (T026-T033) are largely unchecked. Similar to US-1, this creates a state where tests exist for unimplemented functionality. The plan should clarify if this is a TDD state or if the tests are placeholders.

T034-T035 (Tests for US-3) are unchecked, while T036-T037 (Implementation) are also unchecked. This is consistent, but the lack of any checked tasks in Phase 5 (except T038a which is also unchecked) indicates a complete absence of work on US-3. The plan should reflect the current 'zero progress' state more clearly or prioritize the first task.
